verses.original: Ἐγένοντο δὲ καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐν τῷ λαῷ ὡς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσονται ψευδοδιδάσκαλοι οἵτινες παρεισάξουσιν αἱρέσεις ἀπωλείας καὶ τὸν ἀγοράσαντα αὐτοὺς δεσπότην ἀρνούμενοι ἐπάγοντες ἑαυτοῖς ταχινὴν ἀπώλειαν
verses.transliteration: Egenonto de kai pseudoprophētai en tō laō hōs kai en hymin esontai pseudodidaskaloi hoitines pareisaxousin haireseis apōleias kai ton agorasanta autous despotēn arnoumenoi epagontes heautois tachinēn apōleian
verses.literal: Now there were also false prophets among the people just as there will be false teachers among you They will secretly introduce destructive heresies even denying the Master who bought them bringing swift destruction on themselves
verses.literalPt: E TAMBÉM houve entre o povo falsos profetas, como entre vós haverá também falsos doutores, que introduzirão encobertamente heresias de perdição, e negarão o Senhor que os resgatou, trazendo sobre si mesmos repentina perdição.

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐξακολουθήσουσιν αὐτῶν ταῖς ἀσελγείαις δι’ οὓς ἡ ὁδὸς τῆς ἀληθείας βλασφημηθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai polloi exakolouthēsousin autōn tais aselgeiais di’ hous hē hodos tēs alētheias blasphēmēthēsetai
verses.literal: Many will follow in their depravity and because of them the way of truth will be defamed
verses.literalPt: E muitos seguirão as suas dissoluções, pelos quais será blasfemado o caminho da verdade.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ πλαστοῖς λόγοις ὑμᾶς ἐμπορεύσονται οἷς τὸ κρίμα ἔκπαλαι οὐκ ἀργεῖ καὶ ἡ ἀπώλεια αὐτῶν οὐ νυστάζει
verses.transliteration: kai en pleonexia plastois logois hymas emporeusontai hois to krima ekpalai ouk argei kai hē apōleia autōn ou nystazei
verses.literal: In their greed these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words The longstanding verdict against them remains in force and their destruction does not sleep
verses.literalPt: E por avareza farão de vós negócio com palavras fingidas; sobre os quais já de largo tempo não será tardia a sentença, e a sua perdição não dormita.

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς ἀγγέλων ἁμαρτησάντων οὐκ ἐφείσατο ἀλλὰ σειραῖς ζόφου ταρταρώσας παρέδωκεν εἰς κρίσιν τηρουμένους
verses.transliteration: Ei gar ho Theos angelōn hamartēsantōn ouk epheisato alla seirais zophou tartarōsas paredōken eis krisin tēroumenous
verses.literal: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned but cast them deep into hell placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment
verses.literalPt: Porque, se Deus não perdoou aos anjos que pecaram, mas, havendo-os lançado no inferno, os entregou às cadeias da escuridão, ficando reservados para o juízo;

verses.original: καὶ ἀρχαίου κόσμου οὐκ ἐφείσατο ἀλλὰ ὄγδοον Νῶε δικαιοσύνης κήρυκα ἐφύλαξεν κατακλυσμὸν κόσμῳ ἀσεβῶν ἐπάξας
verses.transliteration: kai archaiou kosmou ouk epheisato alla ogdoon Nōe dikaiosynēs kēryka ephylaxen kataklysmon kosmō asebōn epaxas
verses.literal: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people but preserved Noah a preacher of righteousness among the eight
verses.literalPt: E não perdoou ao mundo antigo, mas guardou a Noé, pregoeiro da justiça, com mais sete pessoas, ao trazer o dilúvio sobre o mundo dos ímpios;

verses.original: καὶ πόλεις Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρας τεφρώσας καταστροφῇ κατέκρινεν ὑπόδειγμα μελλόντων ἀσεβέσιν τεθεικώς
verses.transliteration: kai poleis Sodomōn kai Gomorras tephrōsas katastrophē katekrinen hypodeigma mellontōn asebesin tetheikōs
verses.literal: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly
verses.literalPt: E condenou à destruição as cidades de Sodoma e Gomorra, reduzindo-as a cinza, e pondo-as para exemplo aos que vivessem impiamente;

verses.original: καὶ δίκαιον Λὼτ καταπονούμενον ὑπὸ τῆς τῶν ἀθέσμων ἐν ἀσελγείᾳ ἀναστροφῆς ἐρρύσατο
verses.transliteration: kai dikaion Lōt kataponoumenon hypo tēs tōn athesmōn en aselgeia anastrophēs errysato
verses.literal: and if He rescued Lot a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
verses.literalPt: E livrou o justo Ló, enfadado da vida dissoluta dos homens abomináveis

verses.original: βλέμματι γὰρ καὶ ἀκοῇ ὁ δίκαιος ἐνκατοικῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ψυχὴν δικαίαν ἀνόμοις ἔργοις ἐβασάνιζεν
verses.transliteration: blemmati gar kai akoē ho dikaios enkatoikōn en autois hēmeran ex hēmeras psychēn dikaian anomois ergois ebasanizen
verses.literal: (for that righteous man living among them day after day was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard
verses.literalPt: (Porque este justo, habitando entre eles, afligia todos os dias a sua alma justa, vendo e ouvindo sobre as suas obras injustas);

verses.original: οἶδεν Κύριος εὐσεβεῖς ἐκ πειρασμοῦ ῥύεσθαι ἀδίκους δὲ εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως κολαζομένους τηρεῖν
verses.transliteration: oiden Kyrios eusebeis ek peirasmou rhyesthai adikous de eis hēmeran kriseōs kolazomenous tērein
verses.literal: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment
verses.literalPt: Assim, sabe o Senhor livrar da tentação os piedosos, e reservar os injustos para o dia do juízo, para serem castigados;

verses.original: μάλιστα δὲ τοὺς ὀπίσω σαρκὸς ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ μιασμοῦ πορευομένους καὶ κυριότητος καταφρονοῦντας τολμηταὶ αὐθάδεις δόξας οὐ τρέμουσιν βλασφημοῦντες
verses.transliteration: malista de tous opisō sarkos en epithymia miasmou poreuomenous kai kyriotētos kataphronountas tolmētai authadeis doxas ou tremousin blasphēmountes
verses.literal: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge . . . the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority Bold and self-willed they are unafraid to slander glorious beings
verses.literalPt: Mas principalmente aqueles que segundo a carne andam em concupiscências de imundícia, e desprezam as autoridades; atrevidos, obstinados, não receando blasfemar das dignidades;

verses.original: ὅπου ἄγγελοι ἰσχύϊ καὶ δυνάμει μείζονες ὄντες οὐ φέρουσιν κατ’ αὐτῶν παρὰ Κυρίῳ βλάσφημον κρίσιν
verses.transliteration: hopou angeloi ischui kai dynamei meizones ontes ou pherousin kat’ autōn para Kyriō blasphēmon krisin
verses.literal: Yet not even . . . angels though greater in strength and power dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord
verses.literalPt: Enquanto os anjos, sendo maiores em força e poder, não pronunciam contra eles juízo blasfemo diante do Senhor.

verses.original: Οὗτοι δέ ὡς ἄλογα ζῷα γεγεννημένα φυσικὰ εἰς ἅλωσιν καὶ φθοράν ἐν οἷς ἀγνοοῦσιν βλασφημοῦντες ἐν τῇ φθορᾷ αὐτῶν καὶ φθαρήσονται
verses.transliteration: Houtoi de hōs aloga zōa gegennēmena physika eis halōsin kai phthoran en hois agnoousin blasphēmountes en tē phthora autōn kai phtharēsontai
verses.literal: These men are like irrational animals creatures of instinct born to be captured and destroyed They blaspheme in matters they do not understand and like such creatures . . . . . . . . . they too will be destroyed
verses.literalPt: Mas estes, como animais irracionais, que seguem a natureza, feitos para serem presos e mortos, blasfemando do que não entendem, perecerão na sua corrupção,

verses.original: ἀδικούμενοι μισθὸν ἀδικίας ἡδονὴν ἡγούμενοι τὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τρυφήν σπίλοι καὶ μῶμοι ἐντρυφῶντες ἐν ταῖς ἀπάταις αὐτῶν συνευωχούμενοι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: adikoumenoi misthon adikias hēdonēn hēgoumenoi tēn en hēmera tryphēn spiloi kai mōmoi entryphōntes en tais apatais autōn syneuōchoumenoi hymin
verses.literal: The harm they will suffer is the wages of their wickedness They consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight They are blots and blemishes reveling in their deception as they feast with you
verses.literalPt: Recebendo o galardão da injustiça; pois que tais homens têm prazer nos deleites quotidianos; nódoas são eles e máculas, deleitando-se em seus enganos, quando se banqueteiam convosco;

verses.original: ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντες μεστοὺς μοιχαλίδος καὶ ἀκαταπαύστους ἁμαρτίας δελεάζοντες ψυχὰς ἀστηρίκτους καρδίαν γεγυμνασμένην πλεονεξίας ἔχοντες κατάρας τέκνα
verses.transliteration: ophthalmous echontes mestous moichalidos kai akatapaustous hamartias deleazontes psychas astēriktous kardian gegymnasmenēn pleonexias echontes kataras tekna
verses.literal: Their eyes are full of adultery their desire for sin is never satisfied . . . they seduce the unstable . . . They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed
verses.literalPt: Tendo os olhos cheios de adultério, e não cessando de pecar, engodando as almas inconstantes, tendo o coração exercitado na avareza, filhos de maldição;

verses.original: Καταλιπόντες εὐθεῖαν ὁδὸν ἐπλανήθησαν ἐξακολουθήσαντες τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ τοῦ Βεώρ ὃς μισθὸν ἀδικίας ἠγάπησεν
verses.transliteration: Katalipontes eutheian hodon eplanēthēsan exakolouthēsantes tē hodō tou Balaam tou Beōr hos misthon adikias ēgapēsen
verses.literal: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor who loved the wages of wickedness
verses.literalPt: Os quais, deixando o caminho direito, erraram seguindo o caminho de Balaão, filho de Beor, que amou o prêmio da injustiça;

verses.original: ἔλεγξιν δὲ ἔσχεν ἰδίας παρανομίας ὑποζύγιον ἄφωνον ἐν ἀνθρώπου φωνῇ φθεγξάμενον ἐκώλυσεν τὴν τοῦ προφήτου παραφρονίαν
verses.transliteration: elenxin de eschen idias paranomias hypozygion aphōnon en anthrōpou phōnē phthenxamenon ekōlysen tēn tou prophētou paraphronian
verses.literal: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey otherwise without speech that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness
verses.literalPt: Mas teve a repreensão da sua transgressão; o mudo jumento, falando com voz humana, impediu a loucura do profeta.

verses.original: Οὗτοί εἰσιν πηγαὶ ἄνυδροι καὶ ὁμίχλαι ὑπὸ λαίλαπος ἐλαυνόμεναι οἷς ὁ ζόφος τοῦ σκότους τετήρηται
verses.transliteration: Houtoi eisin pēgai anydroi kai homichlai hypo lailapos elaunomenai hois ho zophos tou skotous tetērētai
verses.literal: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm Blackest darkness is reserved for them
verses.literalPt: Estes são fontes sem água, nuvens levadas pela força do vento, para os quais a escuridão das trevas eternamente se reserva.

verses.original: ὑπέρογκα γὰρ ματαιότητος φθεγγόμενοι δελεάζουσιν ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις σαρκὸς ἀσελγείαις τοὺς ὀλίγως ἀποφεύγοντας τοὺς ἐν πλάνῃ ἀναστρεφομένους
verses.transliteration: hyperonka gar mataiotētos phthengomenoi deleazousin en epithymiais sarkos aselgeiais tous oligōs apopheugontas tous en planē anastrephomenous
verses.literal: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error
verses.literalPt: Porque, falando coisas mui arrogantes de vaidades, engodam com as concupiscências da carne, e com dissoluções, aqueles que se estavam afastando dos que andam em erro,

verses.original: ἐλευθερίαν αὐτοῖς ἐπαγγελλόμενοι αὐτοὶ δοῦλοι ὑπάρχοντες τῆς φθορᾶς ᾧ γάρ τις ἥττηται τούτῳ καὶ δεδούλωται
verses.transliteration: eleutherian autois epangellomenoi autoi douloi hyparchontes tēs phthoras hō gar tis hēttētai toutō kai dedoulōtai
verses.literal: They promise them freedom while they themselves are slaves to depravity For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him
verses.literalPt: Prometendo-lhes liberdade, sendo eles mesmos servos da corrupção. Porque de quem alguém é vencido, do tal faz-se também servo.

verses.original: Εἰ γὰρ ἀποφυγόντες τὰ μιάσματα τοῦ κόσμου ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τούτοις δὲ πάλιν ἐμπλακέντες ἡττῶνται γέγονεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ἔσχατα χείρονα τῶν πρώτων
verses.transliteration: Ei gar apophygontes ta miasmata tou kosmou en epignōsei tou Kyriou kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou toutois de palin emplakentes hēttōntai gegonen autois ta eschata cheirona tōn prōtōn
verses.literal: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ only to be entangled and overcome by it again their final condition is worse than it was at first
verses.literalPt: Porquanto se, depois de terem escapado das corrupções do mundo, pelo conhecimento do Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo, forem outra vez envolvidos nelas e vencidos, tornou-se-lhes o último estado pior do que o primeiro.

verses.original: κρεῖττον γὰρ ἦν αὐτοῖς μὴ ἐπεγνωκέναι τὴν ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης ἢ ἐπιγνοῦσιν ὑποστρέψαι ἐκ τῆς παραδοθείσης αὐτοῖς ἁγίας ἐντολῆς
verses.transliteration: kreitton gar ēn autois mē epegnōkenai tēn hodon tēs dikaiosynēs ē epignousin hypostrepsai ek tēs paradotheisēs autois hagias entolēs
verses.literal: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them
verses.literalPt: Porque melhor lhes fora não conhecerem o caminho da justiça, do que, conhecendo-o, desviarem-se do santo mandamento que lhes fora dado;

verses.original: συμβέβηκεν αὐτοῖς τὸ τῆς ἀληθοῦς παροιμίας Κύων ἐπιστρέψας ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον ἐξέραμα καί Ὗς λουσαμένη εἰς κυλισμὸν βορβόρου
verses.transliteration: symbebēken autois to tēs alēthous paroimias Kyōn epistrepsas epi to idion exerama kai Hys lousamenē eis kylismon borborou
verses.literal: Of them the proverbs are true A dog returns to its vomit and A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud
verses.literalPt: Deste modo sobreveio-lhes o que por um verdadeiro provérbio se diz: O cão voltou ao seu próprio vômito, e a porca lavada ao espojadouro de lama.
